notes.title: Version 0.90 Animals in the city
notes.content:
Version 0.90
1. Animal System.
When players get a new quest, there will be animal camps randomly created on the target zones. Players can catch them by just left click mouse, and animals will be automatically added to according buildings that built after.

There are 9 kinds of animals, when put into new building, them will provide kinds of resources or increase the environment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38799944/a9d8d223eb229fb56b6a9c8e14220d8b82cfb816.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38799944/996663cc40953784161177113cf58c7254b89b6e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38799944/860e0db4f01948d07fc4b702e23b3b8293960f58.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38799944/fc544630679ba3bff1a9ac7fd891a8ef0d1b2c32.jpg[/img]

2. Quest System.
The quest system is streamlined, players can see the progress more easily on the screen.

3. Public buildings like watch tower, tavern will be constructed immediately.

notes.title: Upgrade version 0.80
notes.content:
1. Add floating tips on buttons of all resources, building types and major functions.
2. Add decorations on buttons of main menu.

notes.title: Update Version 0.78
notes.content:
1. Correct the texture of city walls and city gates, from concreate grey into dirt yellow, just as they were in history. Thanks Woody and addamsone for suggestions.

2. Fix a bug that the platform still be highlighted when deselect a building.

3. Upgrade the texture of Danfeng Gate, Mingde Gate and Zhuque Gate into 4k size.

notes.title: Update version 0.75
notes.content:
1. Add label on the historical sites, can press Space button to turn on/off.
2. Change the color of roof beam of buildings from red to green.
3. Beautify the UI.

notes.title: Update version 0.74
notes.content:
1. Add guards patrolling on the palace wall.
2. Add some effect on the difficulty select UI and emperor select UI.
3. Click on water supply or garden building will show the water supply or virescence areas.
4. Unify the price of all the buildings of Daming Palace.
5. Beautified the UI on the buttom.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38799944/16e2360d9c50ec110ef14902fbc208480816e286.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 0,73 Update
notes.content:
1. New game music added to the play list.
2. Special sound effect when build and click gardens.
3. Fixed a bug that business zone some times lack water even there are water supply buildings nearby.
4. Fixed the level requirement tips in the quest page.
5. Fixed the level requirement tips in the poet page.

[b]Goals of the next update:[/b]
[i]1. Guards on the palace gate and city wall.
2. Beautified UI.[/i]
